title: Intergenerational Mobility by Sexuality
title_zh: 性取向的代际流动性
title_primary: 性取向的代际流动性
title_secondary: Intergenerational Mobility by Sexuality
authors: Fane Groes, Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen, Morten Kjær Thomsen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Intergenerational mobility has been shown to vary across groups defined by family-level characteristics such as race, neighbourhood, and parental immigration status. We provide the first population-wide evidence that the relationship between parental background and adult children's earnings, health, fertility, and family formation is also stratified by sexuality – an individual-level characteristic that varies within families. To do so, we develop a new strategy to identify same-sex and different-sex couples in Danish administrative data using joint financial commitments. Our approach mitigates limitations associated with non-representative surveys and cross-sectional data on sexuality. Drawing on identity economics and minority stress theory, we propose a conceptual framework in which deviation from the social prescription of different-sex attraction generates identity costs that may decline with parental resources through reduced exposure to discrimination and enhanced coping capacity. Empirically, we find that disparities generally persist across the parental income distribution, though severe mental health conditions are particularly elevated among same-sex attracted individuals from low-income families. We explore parent-child relationships as potential mechanisms, finding that same-sex attracted individuals live farther from parents across the income distribution. Results are robust to controlling for unobserved parental heterogeneity through sibling fixed effects, though they vary across childhood regions and cohorts. Our findings suggest that intergenerational mobility varies not only with factors shared by siblings but also with individual-level characteristics, such as sexuality.
abstract_zh: 代际流动性已被证明会因家庭层面特征（如种族、社区和父母移民身份）所定义的群体而异。我们提供了首个全人口范围的证据，表明父母背景与成年子女收入、健康、生育及家庭形成之间的关系也因性取向——一种家庭内部存在差异的个体层面特征——而分层。为此，我们开发了一种新策略，利用丹麦行政数据中的联合财务承诺来识别同性伴侣和异性伴侣。我们的方法缓解了与非代表性调查和性取向横截面数据相关的局限性。借鉴身份经济学和少数群体压力理论，我们提出了一个概念框架，其中偏离异性吸引的社会规范会产生身份成本，这些成本可能因父母资源而降低，其机制是通过减少歧视暴露和增强应对能力。实证上，我们发现这些差异通常在整个父母收入分布中持续存在，尽管严重心理健康状况在来自低收入家庭、受同性吸引的个体中尤为突出。我们探讨了亲子关系作为潜在机制，发现受同性吸引的个体在收入分布各层次中均居住得离父母更远。结果在通过兄弟姐妹固定效应控制未观察到的父母异质性后依然稳健，但随童年地区和出生队列的不同而有所变化。我们的发现表明，代际流动性不仅随兄弟姐妹共享的因素而变化，还随性取向等个体层面特征而变化。

title: Do managerial incentives facilitate anti-competitive behavior? Evidence from collusion
title_zh: 管理层激励是否助长了反竞争行为？来自合谋的证据
title_primary: 管理层激励是否助长了反竞争行为？来自合谋的证据
title_secondary: Do managerial incentives facilitate anti-competitive behavior? Evidence from collusion
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether executive pay structures encourage explicit collusion. This is particularly important as the manager determines the firm’s strategy. We link US cartel cases to executive remuneration and firm data for 1994–2017 to exploit variation in the long-term share of compensation using an instrumental variables estimation approach. Our results indicate that a larger share of long-term compensation increases both cartel participation and initiation. This is consistent with a mechanism in which long-term incentives tie managerial wealth to the continuation of profits above the competitive level and reduce gains from deviation. The effects are primarily driven by equity components. In particular, equity-based risk-taking incentives are positively associated with collusion. The results are more pronounced in less competitive industries and among more innovative firms. Our findings imply a governance trade-off: incentive schemes that better align managers with shareholders can raise the incentive to collude. For enforcement purposes, executive pay design is useful for screening and risk assessment.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了高管薪酬结构是否鼓励显性合谋。鉴于管理者决定企业战略，这一点尤为重要。我们将美国卡特尔案件与1994-2017年间的高管薪酬及企业数据相结合，利用工具变量估计方法，探究长期薪酬占比的变化。研究结果表明，长期薪酬占比越高，参与和发起卡特尔的可能性越大。这与一种机制相符：长期激励将管理者财富与高于竞争水平的持续利润挂钩，从而减少了背离合谋的收益。这些效应主要由股权部分驱动。特别是，基于股权的风险承担激励与合谋呈正相关。在竞争程度较低的行业及更具创新性的企业中，这一结果更为显著。我们的发现意味着一种治理权衡：使管理者与股东利益更一致的激励方案，可能提高合谋的动机。就执法而言，高管薪酬设计有助于筛选和风险评估。

title_secondary: Carbon risk in loan pricing: Commitment channels and real effects
authors: Yao Dong, Martina Hengge, Fabian Valencia, Richard Varghese
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Transition risks related to climate change are increasingly recognised in equity and bond markets. This column uses syndicated loan tranches issued to US firms to study how carbon risk is priced. It finds robust evidence that firms with higher carbon intensity face higher loan spreads. However, this carbon premium has declined and effectively disappeared in recent years, though it increases during periods of monetary tightening. Borrowers that signal environmental commitment pay lower loan risk spreads and undertake higher capital and R&D expenditure, but the discount shrinks as carbon intensity rises.
abstract_zh: 与气候变化相关的转型风险在股票和债券市场中日益受到认可。本文利用发放给美国企业的银团贷款批次，研究碳风险如何被定价。研究发现，碳强度较高的企业面临更高的贷款利差，这一证据稳健。然而，这种碳溢价近年来有所下降并实际上消失，尽管在货币紧缩时期会上升。表明环境承诺的借款人支付较低的贷款风险利差，并进行更高的资本和研发支出，但随着碳强度的增加，这一折扣会缩小。

title: Demand, Competition, and Public Policy in the Automobile Industry
title_zh: 汽车行业的需求、竞争与公共政策
title_primary: 汽车行业的需求、竞争与公共政策
title_secondary: Demand, Competition, and Public Policy in the Automobile Industry
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We review the flourishing literature on the automobile industry since the seminal work of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995), or briefly BLP. Their work provides a structural equilibrium framework that forms a basis for conducting policy counterfactuals in several key areas of interest: competition policy and antitrust, trade policy, and taxation and environmental policy. The demand side of the ‘BLP framework’ is micro-founded and allows for rich consumer heterogeneity to generate flexible substitution patterns between products. The supply side specifies marginal costs and accounts for imperfect competition. Our analysis focuses on two main questions. First, how has the framework been tailored to specific situations and how convincingly has it been evaluated to generate trust in the empirical findings and policy conclusions? Second, what has been learned about policy issues relevant in the automotive industry using the BLP equilibrium framework?
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了自Berry、Levinsohn与Pakes（1995，简称BLP）开创性研究以来蓬勃发展的汽车产业文献。其构建的结构性均衡框架为竞争政策与反垄断、贸易政策、税收与环境政策等关键领域的政策反事实分析奠定了基础。BLP框架的需求侧具有微观基础，通过丰富的消费者异质性刻画产品间的灵活替代模式；供给侧则明确边际成本设定并纳入不完全竞争因素。我们的分析聚焦两大核心问题：第一，该框架如何针对特定情境进行适应性调整，其评估过程在多大程度上能令人信服地支撑实证发现与政策结论？第二，借助BLP均衡框架，我们对汽车产业相关政策议题获得了哪些认知？

title: Socioeconomic and policy-triggered land use/land cover change in the Alwero Watershed, Gambela Region, Ethiopia
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区阿尔韦罗流域社会经济与政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖变化
title_primary: 埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区阿尔韦罗流域社会经济与政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖变化
title_secondary: Socioeconomic and policy-triggered land use/land cover change in the Alwero Watershed, Gambela Region, Ethiopia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Policy‑triggered land-use/land-cover (LULC) change is a critical global challenge, particularly in tropical regions, where agricultural expansion and investment policies are accelerating forest loss and ecosystem degradation. In the study area, most prior studies emphasized biophysical dynamics, with limited attention to how land policies, tenure insecurity, refugee inflows, resettlement programs, and cross-border pastoralist mobility shape LULC change. Therefore, this study addresses these gaps by analyzing the association between socioeconomic dynamics, land-related policies, and LULC change from 1987 to 2025. A mixed-methods approach combined analysis of multi-temporal Landsat imagery with key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and policy reviews. Quantitative analysis showed that farmland area expanded from 100,998 ha (38.9%) in 1987–181,953 ha (70.1%) in 2025. Forest cover declined from 9680.7 ha (3.7%) to 7445.3 ha (2.8%), while wetlands and grasslands decreased from 41.4% to 21.1%, nearly halving their extent. Qualitative evidence also highlights the influxes of displaced communities, degradation of wetlands and protected areas, declining traditional livelihoods, and intensified land-use conflicts. Commercial land leases under Proclamation No. 280/2002 and 456/2005 were strongly associated with farmland expansion, while wetland loss was linked to cross-border pastoralist inflows. Settlement growth was driven by government-led resettlement and villagization programs, compounded by large-scale refugee influxes, which collectively increased flood risks, vegetation loss, and biodiversity decline. Weak policy enforcement, tenure insecurity, and poor management of refugee settlements, cross-border pastoral movements, and prioritization of investment for large-scale agricultural investments were identified as key drivers associated with LULC change. The study calls for institutional reforms to formalize customary land rights, regulate refugee settlements and pastoral mobility, strengthen participatory watershed management, and promote eco-tourism to achieve equity and resilience. Overall, the findings also underscore the urgent need for evidence-based policies that balance economic ambition with ecological resilience, tenure security, and social equity.
abstract_zh: 政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）变化是全球面临的重大挑战，尤其在热带地区，农业扩张和投资政策正加速森林丧失和生态系统退化。在研究区域内，以往多数研究侧重于生物物理动态，而对土地政策、权属不安全、难民流入、重新安置计划及跨境牧民流动如何影响LULC变化的关注有限。因此，本研究通过分析1987年至2025年间社会经济动态、土地相关政策与LULC变化之间的关联，填补了上述空白。采用混合方法，结合多时相Landsat影像分析与关键知情人访谈、焦点小组讨论及政策审查。定量分析显示，农田面积从1987年的100,998公顷（38.9%）扩展至2025年的181,953公顷（70.1%）。森林覆盖率从9680.7公顷（3.7%）下降至7445.3公顷（2.8%），而湿地和草地面积从41.4%减少至21.1%，几乎减半。定性证据亦凸显了流离失所社区的涌入、湿地和保护区退化、传统生计衰退以及土地利用冲突加剧。第280/2002号和456/2005号公告下的商业土地租赁与农田扩张密切相关，而湿地丧失则与跨境牧民流入有关。定居点增长受政府主导的重新安置和村庄化计划驱动，加之大规模难民涌入，共同加剧了洪水风险、植被丧失和生物多样性下降。政策执行不力、权属不安全、难民定居点及跨境牧民流动管理不善，以及优先考虑大规模农业投资，被确定为与LULC变化相关的关键驱动因素。本研究呼吁进行制度性改革，以正式承认习惯土地权利、规范难民定居和牧民流动、加强参与式流域管理，并促进生态旅游，以实现公平与韧性。总体而言，研究结果亦强调了亟需基于证据的政策，以平衡经济雄心与生态韧性、权属安全和社会公平。

title: Analyzing Occupational Licensing Across Nations
title_zh: 跨国职业许可制度分析
title_primary: 跨国职业许可制度分析
title_secondary: Analyzing Occupational Licensing Across Nations
authors: Jonathan S. Hartley, Morris M. Kleiner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Relatively little is known about occupational licensing across nations. Despite a large literature on occupational licensing in the United States, cross-national evidence remains scarce, especially for developing economies. We assemble harmonized estimates of licensing prevalence for 44 countries by combining new nationally representative surveys (including newly conducted nationally representative surveys for a number of previously unstudied countries) for several Latin American, African, Asian, European, and North American estimates. We document substantial cross-country dispersion in occupational licensing prevalence, ranging from roughly 14 percent of workers in Denmark to more than 40 percent in India and South Africa, the two most heavily licensed labor markets in our sample. Across countries, licensed workers generally earn higher wages than comparable unlicensed workers, with pooled Mincerian regressions indicating licensing wage premia ranging from roughly 6 to 19 percent depending on weighting and specification choices. Occupational licensing prevalence is also negatively associated with GDP per capita and governance quality, and positively associated with informal employment. While these relationships are descriptive rather than causal, they suggest that occupational licensing may be intertwined with broader institutional characteristics affecting labor market efficiency, formal-sector participation, and long-run economic development.
abstract_zh: 关于各国职业许可的研究相对较少。尽管美国已有大量关于职业许可的文献，但跨国证据仍然稀缺，尤其是针对发展中经济体。我们通过整合新的全国代表性调查（包括针对多个此前未被研究的国家新开展的全国代表性调查），为拉丁美洲、非洲、亚洲、欧洲和北美的44个国家构建了统一的职业许可普及率估计值。我们记录了各国职业许可普及率的显著差异，从丹麦约14%的工人到印度和南非超过40%——这两个样本中职业许可程度最高的劳动力市场。跨国数据显示，持有职业许可的工人通常比未持许可的同类工人获得更高工资，混合明瑟回归表明，根据权重和模型设定选择的不同，职业许可工资溢价约为6%至19%。职业许可普及率还与人均GDP和治理质量呈负相关，与非正规就业呈正相关。尽管这些关系是描述性而非因果性的，但它们表明职业许可可能与影响劳动力市场效率、正规部门参与度及长期经济发展的更广泛制度特征相互交织。

title: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
title_zh: 同行院校网络、可选考试录取政策与STEM专业完成率
title_primary: 同行院校网络、可选考试录取政策与STEM专业完成率
title_secondary: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To investigate the heterogeneous impacts of test-optional policies, I construct a network of private colleges based on their self-reported peer institutions and detect communities within it using a network science algorithm. I then estimate treatment effects by comparing adopters and non-adopters within the same community. I show how restricting to within-community comparisons drastically attenuates the severe pre-trends that arise when all untreated units serve as controls, suggesting that, within community, a parallel counterfactual trends assumption is satisfied. Overall, adoption substantially increases reported SAT scores, making adopting schools appear more selective, but decreases the share of bachelor’s degree completions in STEM, suggesting that marginally enrolled students are much less likely to complete a STEM degree than those they have displaced. Effects vary by community; at the most selective liberal arts colleges, policy adoption causes an 8 (26) percent decline in the share of all (under-represented minority) bachelor’s completions with a STEM major.
abstract_zh: 为探究选择性考试政策（test-optional）的异质性影响，我基于私立学院自我报告的同行院校构建了一个网络，并运用网络科学算法识别其中的社群。随后，我通过比较同一社群内的采纳者与非采纳者来估计处理效应。我展示了将比较限制在社群内部如何大幅减弱当所有未处理单位作为对照组时出现的严重预趋势，这表明在社群内部，平行反事实趋势假设得以满足。总体而言，政策采纳显著提高了报告的SAT分数，使采纳学校显得更具选择性，但降低了STEM领域学士学位完成比例，这表明边际入学学生完成STEM学位的可能性远低于他们所取代的学生。效应因社群而异；在最具选择性的文理学院中，政策采纳导致STEM专业学士学位完成比例总体下降8%，少数族裔群体下降26%。

title: The fragility of the partisan inflation gap: Evidence from the United Kingdom
title_zh: 党派通胀差距的脆弱性：来自英国的证据
title_primary: 党派通胀差距的脆弱性：来自英国的证据
title_secondary: The fragility of the partisan inflation gap: Evidence from the United Kingdom
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Partisan theory predicts that left-leaning governments tolerate higher inflation, and UK data appear to confirm it. Before 1997, inflation averaged three percentage points higher under Labour than the Conservatives. I show this gap is not robust. It is the product of a single Labour government (1974–79) that coincided with the OPEC oil shocks; a randomisation test at the level of governments returns p = 0.50 , and omitting any one of nine governments can swing the gap by up to four points. With so few in the sample, the data cannot sustain the partisan effect they appear to show.
abstract_zh: 党派理论预测，左倾政府更能容忍较高的通货膨胀，英国的数据似乎证实了这一点。1997年前，工党执政期间的平均通胀率比保守党高出三个百分点。我证明这一差距并不稳健。它源于一个特定的工党政府（1974-79年），该时期恰逢OPEC石油冲击；在政府层面的随机化检验得出p=0.50，且剔除九个政府中的任何一个，差距可波动高达四个百分点。鉴于样本量如此之少，数据无法支撑其表面所显示的党派效应。

title: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
title_zh: 逆向选择下的企业并购
title_primary: 逆向选择下的企业并购
title_secondary: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.
abstract_zh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，并购可以通过减少低效分类来提高福利。我在一个易于处理的离散选择模型中刻画了并购企业之间内部化的分类外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度递增且消费者成本呈偏态分布时，并购对消费者有利。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，13%的潜在并购将改善消费者剩余。在分类扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的并购会提升消费者剩余，这凸显了在并购评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。

title: Planning Capital and Discovery-Based Learning-by-Doing: Investment as Staged Discovery in the Hyperscale Era
title_zh: 规划资本与基于发现的干中学：超大规模时代的投资作为分阶段发现
title_primary: 规划资本与基于发现的干中学：超大规模时代的投资作为分阶段发现
title_secondary: Planning Capital and Discovery-Based Learning-by-Doing: Investment as Staged Discovery in the Hyperscale Era
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper treats frontier investment as staged discovery. Firms invest through sequences of costly inquiry stages before deciding whether and how to realize value. At each stage, a firm may sharpen its diagnostic understanding, choose what question to ask, embody that question in a costly action, and interpret the answer that action produces. The answer changes what the firm knows, what it can do next, and how costly future inquiry will be. Successful histories can also carry over to later related problems, making the firm a better learner beyond the current investment path. The paper calls the resulting asset planning capital in firm form. Planning capital is the accumulated diagnostic understanding a firm has built through costly inquiry and operation: understanding of technologies, processes, customers, tools, partners, failures, constraints, and opportunities, together with the capacity to keep learning. It becomes valuable because it helps the firm choose what to investigate, make the question answerable, interpret what happened, and carry what it learned into later investment stages. Building on classical investment theory, R&D models, real-options theory, venture-capital models, classical learning-by-doing, the paper develops a model of investment as staged discovery. The AI and semiconductor frontier makes this asset visible. Firms are being valued and funded for more than the physical capacity they already own. Chips, fabs, data centers, cloud platforms, power commitments, and model systems matter because they carry traces of accumulated learning and because their use generates more learning. They let firms train models, test demand, expose bottlenecks, improve yields, qualify customers, integrate tools, and discover which complements are missing. The current buildout is therefore investment in capacity and in the institutional learning system that makes capacity more valuable over time. The framework explains why production systems, tool systems, research paths, sovereign capability programs, and infrastructure sponsorship belong in the same analysis. They are different institutional forms through which planning capital is accumulated. The paper treats terminal realization value in reduced form and focuses on the discovery process that precedes it: how institutions build capacity, learn from using it, and turn accumulated diagnostic understanding into an advantage in the next round of investment.
abstract_zh: 本文将前沿投资视为分阶段发现的过程。企业通过一系列成本高昂的探究阶段进行投资，随后再决定是否以及如何实现价值。在每个阶段，企业可以深化其诊断性理解，选择要探究的问题，将该问题体现于一项成本高昂的行动中，并解读该行动所产生的答案。答案会改变企业已知的信息、下一步能做什么以及未来探究的成本。成功的经验还可以延续到后续的相关问题，使企业在当前投资路径之外成为更好的学习者。本文将由此产生的资产称为企业形式的规划资本。规划资本是企业通过成本高昂的探究与运营所积累的诊断性理解：对技术、流程、客户、工具、合作伙伴、失败、约束与机遇的理解，以及持续学习的能力。它之所以有价值，是因为它帮助企业选择要调查什么、使问题可回答、解读所发生之事，并将所学带入后续投资阶段。本文基于经典投资理论、研发模型、实物期权理论、风险投资模型以及经典干中学理论，构建了一个将投资视为分阶段发现的模型。人工智能与半导体前沿使这一资产变得可见。企业的估值与融资依据已超越其已拥有的物理产能。芯片、晶圆厂、数据中心、云平台、电力承诺与模型系统之所以重要，是因为它们承载着积累的学习痕迹，且其使用能产生更多学习。它们让企业能够训练模型、测试需求、暴露瓶颈、提升良率、认证客户、集成工具，并发现哪些互补要素缺失。因此，当前的产能建设既是对产能的投资，也是对制度性学习系统的投资，后者使产能随时间推移更具价值。该框架解释了为何生产系统、工具系统、研究路径、主权能力计划与基础设施资助应被纳入同一分析。它们是规划资本得以积累的不同制度形式。本文以简化形式处理终端实现价值，并聚焦于其前的发现过程：机构如何建设产能、从使用中学习，并将积累的诊断性理解转化为下一轮投资中的优势。

title: The evolution of patriotism
title_zh: 爱国主义演变
title_primary: 爱国主义演变
title_secondary: The evolution of patriotism
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary model of patriotism. The state interacts with a population of citizens who may differ in their levels of patriotism, reflecting how much they care about the state. Citizens’ patriotism is subject to evolutionary pressure in the long run. Under complete information, if the state’s payoff function exhibits strategic complementarity, patriotism can emerge through evolution. In the presence of incomplete information, however, patriotism fails to thrive. Despite this, if citizens can costlessly disclose their levels of patriotism to the state in a truthful but potentially imprecise manner, full information revelation can be achieved under certain monotonicity conditions—one of which can be derived from the supermodularity of the interaction between the state and citizens—thus allowing patriotism to evolve in a manner similar to the complete information case.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于爱国主义的演化模型。国家与一群公民互动，这些公民的爱国主义程度可能不同，反映了他们对国家的关心程度。公民的爱国主义在长期中受到演化压力的影响。在完全信息条件下，如果国家的收益函数表现出策略互补性，爱国主义可以通过演化过程产生。然而，在不完全信息条件下，爱国主义无法蓬勃发展。尽管如此，如果公民能够以真实但可能不精确的方式，无成本地向国家披露其爱国主义程度，则在某些单调性条件下——其中一种条件可源于国家与公民之间互动的超模性——可以实现完全信息揭示，从而使爱国主义得以在类似于完全信息的情形下演化。

title: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation
title_zh: 同伴学习、执行与声誉
title_primary: 同伴学习、执行与声誉
title_secondary: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation
authors: Yi Chen, Kai Du, Phillip Stocken, Zhe Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性特征的监管者致力于建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业则通过其不当行为来试探监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境下（企业间可观察到不当行为与执法行为），监管者的声誉关切会内生地在企业间产生正向或负向的执法外部性。当声誉关切较强时，执法外部性为负向且主导信息外部性，从而助长不当行为；反之，两种外部性均为正向，能够抑制不当行为。尽管在非透明环境下，强大的声誉始终有利于监管者，但在透明环境下，这种声誉往往会产生适得其反的效果。

title: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
title_zh: 公共产品投票：公民与股东
title_primary: 公共产品投票：公民与股东
title_secondary: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
authors: Robin Döttling, Doron Levit, Nadya Malenko, Magdalena Rola-Janicka
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the interplay between a “one person-one vote” political system and a “one share-one vote” corporate governance regime. If shareholders push firms for more prosocial policies, political backlash may arise, undoing these initiatives. If public policy is frictionless, shareholder democracy becomes irrelevant: the political system fully offsets shareholder influence. With public policy frictions, prosocial corporations can mitigate regulatory shortcomings and enhance corporate public goods provision. Nevertheless, shareholder democracy can hurt citizens due to the representation problem: it favors the preferences of the wealthy. Investor diversification, pass-through voting, and corporate greenwashing have important implications for these trade-offs of shareholder democracy. (JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23)
abstract_zh: 我们研究“一人一票”政治体制与“一股一票”公司治理制度之间的相互作用。如果股东推动企业采取更多亲社会政策，可能引发政治反弹，从而抵消这些举措。若公共政策无摩擦，股东民主便失去意义：政治体制将完全抵消股东的影响力。在存在公共政策摩擦的情况下，亲社会企业能够弥补监管缺陷，提升企业公共品供给。然而，由于代表性问题，股东民主可能损害公民利益：它更偏向富裕阶层的偏好。投资者多元化、传递投票以及企业漂绿行为对股东民主的这些权衡具有重要影响。（JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23）

title: Local GDP estimates around the world
title_zh: 全球地方GDP估算
title_primary: 全球地方GDP估算
title_secondary: Local GDP estimates around the world
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use high-resolution spatial data to build a novel global annual gridded GDP dataset at 1°, 0.5°, and 0.25°resolutions from 2012 onwards. Our random forest model trained on local and national GDP achieves an R 2 above 0.94 for GDP levels and above 0.73 for annual changes in regions left out of the training sample. By incorporating diverse indicators beyond population and nighttime lights, our estimates offer more precise subnational GDP measurements for analyzing economic shocks, local policies, and regional disparities. We evaluate the precision of using a case study of COVID-19’s impact on local GDP in China.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高分辨率空间数据，构建了一套自2012年起覆盖全球、分辨率分别为1°、0.5°和0.25°的新型年度网格化GDP数据集。我们的随机森林模型在本地及国家GDP训练下，对GDP水平的R²超过0.94，对训练样本外区域的年度变化R²超过0.73。通过纳入除人口和夜间灯光之外的多样化指标，我们的估算提供了更精确的次国家级GDP测量，适用于分析经济冲击、地方政策及区域差异。我们以COVID-19对中国地方GDP影响为例，评估了该数据的精确性。

title: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
title_zh: 货币政策与内生金融危机
title_primary: 货币政策与内生金融危机
title_secondary: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
authors: F Boissay, F Collard, J Galí, C Manea
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.
abstract_zh: 货币政策通过哪些渠道影响金融稳定？中央银行能否（且是否应当）通过偏离价格稳定目标来预防金融危机？货币政策本身在多大程度上可能无意中滋生金融脆弱性？我们通过构建一个包含资本积累以及信贷市场中逆向选择与道德风险所引发内生金融危机的新凯恩斯模型来回答这些问题。研究结论有三点：第一，货币政策既在短期（通过总需求渠道）也在中期（通过资本积累渠道）影响危机发生概率；第二，中央银行可通过容忍短期通胀波动率上升来降低中期危机发生率；第三，长期宽松货币政策后骤然收紧可能引发金融危机。

title: Consumer heterogeneity and the price-quality relationship
title_zh: 消费者异质性与价格-质量关系
title_primary: 消费者异质性与价格-质量关系
title_secondary: Consumer heterogeneity and the price-quality relationship
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper contributes to the price–quality relationship literature by examining the role of consumer heterogeneity. While theoretical research predominantly supports a positive price–quality relationship, empirical findings reveal a more complex picture. This complexity highlights a theoretical gap in understanding the mixed empirical evidence on the price–quality relationship. To address this gap, we introduce consumer heterogeneity and distinguish between objective and subjective quality. We propose an optimal control framework that unifies these dimensions, capturing both positive and negative price–quality relationships. Our main contribution is to show that heterogeneity in consumer type alone is sufficient for positive and negative price–quality relationships to coexist within the same market.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察消费者异质性的作用，为价格-质量关系文献做出贡献。尽管理论研究主要支持正面的价格-质量关系，实证发现却揭示了更为复杂的图景。这种复杂性凸显了在理解价格-质量关系混合实证证据方面的理论空白。为填补这一空白，我们引入消费者异质性，并区分客观质量与主观质量。我们提出一个最优控制框架，统一这些维度，捕捉正面与负面的价格-质量关系。我们的主要贡献在于表明，仅消费者类型的异质性就足以使正面与负面的价格-质量关系在同一市场中共存。

title: Shifting forces behind RMB internationalization: evidence from the 2025 Triennial Survey
title_zh: 人民币国际化背后的动力转变：来自2025年三年期调查的证据
title_primary: 人民币国际化背后的动力转变：来自2025年三年期调查的证据
title_secondary: Shifting forces behind RMB internationalization: evidence from the 2025 Triennial Survey
authors: Robbert, Juliana, Sushko, Vladyslav, Westermann, Frank
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

title: Are Princelings Truly Busted? Evaluating Transaction Discounts in China's Land Market
title_zh: 中国“太子党”真的破产了吗？——中国土地市场交易折扣评估
title_primary: 中国“太子党”真的破产了吗？——中国土地市场交易折扣评估
title_secondary: Are Princelings Truly Busted? Evaluating Transaction Discounts in China's Land Market
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper replicates Chen and Kung's 2019 analysis ( The Quarterly Journal of Economics 134(1): 185–226). Inspecting the data reveals that nearly one‐third of transactions (388,903 out of 1,208,621) are perfect duplicates of other rows, excluding the transaction number. The analysis of the data sans duplicates replicates their statistically significant princeling effect, robust across various specifications. Further analysis reveals a disagreement between Chen and Kung's text and code: The paper's “logarithm of area” is actually area () divided by one million. This therefore necessitates a reinterpretation of the estimation results, revealing that the princeling effect is extremely large.
abstract_zh: 本文复制了Chen和Kung（2019）在《经济学季刊》上的分析（第134卷，第1期，第185-226页）。检查数据发现，近三分之一的交易记录（1,208,621条中的388,903条）在排除交易编号后，与其他行完全重复。对去除重复后的数据进行分析，复制了他们统计上显著的“太子党”效应，该效应在各种设定下均保持稳健。进一步分析揭示了Chen和Kung文中与代码之间的不一致：论文中的“面积对数”实际上是面积除以一百万。因此，这需要对估计结果进行重新解读，表明“太子党”效应极为显著。

title: Declining female participation: Mechanisms at play in the Viennese private annuity market, c. 1360–1450
title_zh: 女性参与率下降：维也纳私人年金市场的作用机制（约1360–1450年）
title_primary: 女性参与率下降：维也纳私人年金市场的作用机制（约1360–1450年）
title_secondary: Declining female participation: Mechanisms at play in the Viennese private annuity market, c. 1360–1450
official: 官方在线 2026-04-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract During the high and late Middle Ages, the European economy witnessed the emergence and substantial growth of capital markets, a phenomenon connected to urbanization and pestilence, both of which brought profound changes to the social, legal, and economic positions of women. In the second half of the fourteenth century, women participated as both lenders and borrowers in the emerging capital markets of public and private annuities in the Holy Roman Empire, forced loans in northern Italy, and microcredit in Valencia. This heightened level of participation declined at varying speeds across Europe, with women disappearing from some credit markets altogether. Through a novel collection of private annuities from late medieval Vienna, this article examines three channels of financial agency and identifies the mechanisms behind the forces that gradually changed the circumstances of women, leading to a decline in their participation in private credit.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在中世纪中晚期，欧洲经济见证了资本市场的兴起与显著增长，这一现象与城市化及瘟疫紧密相连，两者共同深刻改变了女性的社会、法律及经济地位。十四世纪下半叶，女性以贷方和借方的双重身份，活跃于神圣罗马帝国公共与私人年金的崭新资本市场、意大利北部的强制贷款以及瓦伦西亚的小额信贷中。这种高度的参与度在欧洲各地以不同速度衰退，部分信贷市场中女性身影甚至完全消失。通过一项对中世纪晚期维也纳私人年金的新颖资料收集，本文探讨了金融代理的三个渠道，并揭示了逐渐改变女性境遇、导致她们在私人信贷中参与度下降的机制所在。

title: Active Mutual Fund Common Owners’ Returns and Proxy Voting Behavior
title_zh: 主动型共同基金共同所有者的回报与代理投票行为
title_primary: 主动型共同基金共同所有者的回报与代理投票行为
title_secondary: Active Mutual Fund Common Owners’ Returns and Proxy Voting Behavior
authors: Charoenwong, Ben, Ni, Zhenghui, Ye 等
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-10-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Active equity mutual funds that own shares in product-market competitors have higher risk-adjusted returns, even after fees. This positive association comes from their common ownership positions, and remains robust after controlling for industry concentration, common stock selection, and the tendency to invest in firms with more common ownership. These funds charge higher fees and are active voters: more likely to vote against executive pay-for-performance and for directors with existing directorships in competitors. Our findings suggest that actively managed equity mutual funds are incentivized to soften product-market competition, and proxy voting may serve as a mechanism for influencing corporate policy.
abstract_zh: 摘要 持有产品市场竞争者股份的主动型股票共同基金，在扣除费用后仍能获得更高的风险调整后收益。这一正相关关系源于其共同持股头寸，并且在控制行业集中度、普通股选择以及投资于共同持股较多公司的倾向后依然稳健。这些基金收取更高费用，并作为积极投票者：更可能对高管绩效薪酬投反对票，并支持在竞争对手中已有董事职位的董事。我们的研究结果表明，主动管理型股票共同基金有动机软化产品市场竞争，而代理投票可能作为影响公司政策的一种机制。

title: Robustness of approval-based multiwinner voting rules
title_zh: 基于批准的多人获胜投票规则的稳健性
title_primary: 基于批准的多人获胜投票规则的稳健性
title_secondary: Robustness of approval-based multiwinner voting rules
authors: Piotr Faliszewski, Grzegorz Gawron, Bartosz Kusek
official: 官方在线 2025-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate how robust approval-based multiwinner voting rules are to small perturbations in the votes. In particular, we consider the extent to which a committee can change after we add/remove/swap one approval, and we consider the computational complexity of deciding how many such operations are necessary to change the set of winning committees. We also consider the counting variants of our problems, which can be interpreted as computing the probability that the result of an election changes after a given number of random perturbations of the given election.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了基于批准的多人胜选投票规则对选票微小扰动的稳健性。具体而言，我们考虑在添加、移除或交换一个批准后，委员会可能变化的程度，并研究决定需要多少次此类操作才能改变获胜委员会集合的计算复杂性。我们还考虑了问题的计数变体，这可以解释为计算在给定选举经过一定数量的随机扰动后，选举结果发生变化的概率。
